profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. It reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, and is listed on public exchanges under the ticker IBM with SEC CIK 0000051143. The company's website for this profile centers on IBM OpenPages, which the company describes as a highly scalable, AI-powered, and unified GRC platform for governance, risk, and compliance, available on any cloud or on-premises. The site notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules covering risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. A second product, IBM watsonx.governance, addresses AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, and includes EU AI Act accelerators; it was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. The broader IBM watsonx platform is described as an enterprise AI platform that is model-agnostic and incorporates agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site also references an OpenPages MCP Server intended to enable AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed automation frameworks.

The held facts record no litigation associated with IBM in this dataset. The company maintains a verified presence on this site as of August 30, 2026.
